capabilities: Render plantuml and puml code blocks in preview
Cache include dependency trees and re-render when included files change
Align diagrams left, center, or right with per-diagram overrides
Render via a remote endpoint or a locally run PlantUML PicoWeb server
disambiguation: Not an integration with other apps or a diagram editor; it renders existing PlantUML source into images.
extras: Manifest states the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. In local jar mode the plugin cannot spawn Java itself; the user must start and can register the server at login via generated commands for Windows, macOS, and Linux.
problem: Obsidian natively renders Mermaid diagrams only, so PlantUML source in notes and .puml files stays as raw code without external tooling.

relations.evidence: Runs a local PlantUML PicoWeb server and sends requests to it.
Uses a remote PlantUML-compatible HTTP endpoint (e.g. kroki.io).

requires.name: PlantUML server (Java PicoWeb server started by the user) for local jar mode

summary: PlantUML renderer that turns plantuml/puml code blocks and embedded .puml files into diagrams via a remote or local PlantUML server.
